<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>18 de Facundo</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Luckiest+Guy&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy-deep: #060c1f;
    --navy: #0d1b3d;
    --blue-royal: #1e4b9c;
    --blue-electric: #3f7fe0;
    --silver: #c9d4e3;
    --silver-bright: #f0f4fb;
    --silver-line: rgba(201,212,227,0.28);
  }

  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}

  body{
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -10%, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-deep) 55%, #030814 100%);
    font-family:'Poppins', sans-serif;
    color: var(--silver-bright);
    min-height:100vh;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding: 40px 16px;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    position:relative;
  }

  /* Campo de estrellas / brillos plateados */
  .stars{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    pointer-events:none;
    z-index:0;
  }
  .star{
    position:absolute;
    width:3px;
    height:3px;
    background:var(--silver-bright);
    border-radius:50%;
    opacity:0.5;
    animation: twinkle 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes twinkle{
    0%,100%{opacity:0.15; transform:scale(1);}
    50%{opacity:0.9; transform:scale(1.6);}
  }

  .card{
    position:relative;
    z-index:2;
    width:100%;
    max-width:620px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13,27,61,0.85), rgba(6,12,31,0.95));
    border:1px solid var(--silver-line);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 44px 36px 44px;
    text-align:center;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(63,127,224,0.15), 0 40px 90px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 80px -30px rgba(63,127,224,0.4);
    overflow:hidden;
  }

  .hero-row{
    position:relative;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:6px;
    text-align:center;
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }

  .hero-photo{
    flex-shrink:0;
    width:270px;
    line-height:0;
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }
  .hero-photo img{
    width:100%;
    height:auto;
    display:block;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(63,127,224,0.25));
  }

  .hero-text{
    flex-shrink:0;
    text-align:center;
    width:100%;
  }
  .hero-text .eighteen,
  .hero-text .subtitle,
  .hero-text .name{
    text-align:center;
  }

  @media (max-width:560px){
    .hero-photo{ width:220px; }
    .hero-text .eighteen{ font-size:115px; }
    .hero-text .name{ font-size:34px; }
  }

  /* Rayos de luz tipo foco de fiesta detrás del 18 */
  .spotlight{
    position:absolute;
    top:-120px;
    left:50%;
    width:700px;
    height:700px;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    background: conic-gradient(from 0deg,
      transparent 0deg, rgba(63,127,224,0.14) 8deg, transparent 16deg,
      transparent 40deg, rgba(201,212,227,0.10) 48deg, transparent 56deg,
      transparent 90deg, rgba(63,127,224,0.14) 98deg, transparent 106deg,
      transparent 140deg, rgba(201,212,227,0.10) 148deg, transparent 156deg,
      transparent 190deg, rgba(63,127,224,0.12) 198deg, transparent 206deg,
      transparent 250deg, rgba(201,212,227,0.10) 258deg, transparent 266deg,
      transparent 300deg, rgba(63,127,224,0.12) 308deg, transparent 316deg,
      transparent 340deg, rgba(201,212,227,0.10) 348deg, transparent 360deg);
    animation: rotate 18s linear infinite;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  @keyframes rotate{ to{ transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(360deg); } }

  .eyebrow{
    position:relative;
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:6px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color: var(--blue-electric);
    font-weight:600;
    margin-bottom:18px;
  }

  .eighteen{
    position:relative;
    font-family:'Luckiest Guy', sans-serif;
    font-weight:400;
    font-size: 150px;
    line-height:1.05;
    letter-spacing:2px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--silver-bright) 0%, var(--silver) 45%, var(--blue-electric) 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip:text;
    background-clip:text;
    color:transparent;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(63,127,224,0.55));
    margin-bottom:4px;
    padding-top:6px;
  }

  .subtitle{
    position:relative;
    font-family:'Anton', sans-serif;
    font-size:26px;
    letter-spacing:3px;
    color:var(--silver-bright);
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }

  .name{
    position:relative;
    font-size:44px;
    font-weight:700;
    margin: 6px 0 30px;
    letter-spacing:0.5px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--silver-bright), var(--blue-electric), var(--silver-bright));
    -webkit-background-clip:text;
    background-clip:text;
    color:transparent;
    background-size:220% auto;
    animation: shine 5s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes shine{
    to{ background-position: -220% center; }
  }

  .divider{
    position:relative;
    width:60px;
    height:2px;
    margin: 0 auto 30px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--blue-electric), transparent);
  }

  .details{
    position:relative;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:16px;
    margin-bottom:34px;
  }

  .detail-row{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:14px;
    text-align:left;
    padding:14px 16px;
    border:1px solid var(--silver-line);
    border-radius:2px;
    background: rgba(63,127,224,0.06);
  }

  .detail-icon{
    flex-shrink:0;
    width:34px;
    height:34px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    border-radius:50%;
    background: rgba(63,127,224,0.18);
    border:1px solid var(--silver-line);
  }
  .detail-icon svg{ width:16px; height:16px; }

  .detail-text .label{
    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:2px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--blue-electric);
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }
  .detail-text .value{
    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:500;
    color:var(--silver-bright);
    line-height:1.35;
  }

  .message{
    position:relative;
    font-size:14px;
    line-height:1.7;
    color:var(--silver);
    font-weight:300;
    max-width:340px;
    margin: 0 auto 32px;
  }

  .message strong{ color:var(--silver-bright); font-weight:600; }

  .closing-photo{
    width:150px;
    height:150px;
    border-radius:50%;
    overflow:hidden;
    margin: 0 auto 26px;
    border:3px solid var(--blue-electric);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(63,127,224,0.15), 0 14px 28px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  }
  .closing-photo img{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    object-fit:cover;
    object-position:center 20%;
    display:block;
  }

  .footer-line{
    position:relative;
    display:inline-block;
    font-family:'Anton', sans-serif;
    letter-spacing:4px;
    font-size:15px;
    color:var(--navy-deep);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    text-decoration:none;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--silver-bright), var(--blue-electric));
    padding:14px 30px;
    border-radius:2px;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(63,127,224,0.6);
  }
  .footer-line:hover{
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(63,127,224,0.75);
  }

  .detail-row.location-link{
    text-decoration:none;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .detail-row.location-link:hover{
    background: rgba(63,127,224,0.14);
    border-color: rgba(63,127,224,0.5);
  }

  /* Cuenta regresiva */
  .countdown{
    position:relative;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:12px;
    margin: 0 auto 32px;
  }
  .countdown-unit{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    width:64px;
    padding:12px 0 10px;
    border:1px solid var(--silver-line);
    border-radius:2px;
    background: rgba(63,127,224,0.06);
  }
  .countdown-num{
    font-family:'Anton', sans-serif;
    font-size:30px;
    line-height:1;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--silver-bright), var(--blue-electric));
    -webkit-background-clip:text;
    background-clip:text;
    color:transparent;
  }
  .countdown-label{
    font-size:9px;
    letter-spacing:1.5px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--silver);
    margin-top:6px;
  }

  /* Confetti flotante */
  .confetti{
    position:absolute;
    z-index:1;
    opacity:0.8;
    animation: float 7s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes float{
    0%,100%{ transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
    50%{ transform: translateY(-14px) rotate(180deg); }
  }

  #gift-view{
    position:relative;
    text-align:center;
    padding-top:6px;
  }

  #envelope-view{
    position:relative;
    text-align:center;
    padding: 10px 0 6px;
    transition: opacity 0.45s ease, transform 0.45s ease;
  }
  #envelope-view.closing{
    opacity:0;
    transform: scale(1.2) rotate(4deg);
    pointer-events:none;
  }

  #main-view{
    opacity:0;
    transform: translateY(14px) scale(0.98);
    transition: opacity 0.55s ease, transform 0.55s ease;
  }
  #main-view.visible{
    opacity:1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }

  .flash-burst{
    position:absolute;
    top:50%;
    left:50%;
    width:10px;
    height:10px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background: var(--silver-bright);
    transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0);
    opacity:0;
    pointer-events:none;
    z-index:5;
  }
  .flash-burst.burst{
    animation: flash-burst-anim 0.6s ease-out forwards;
  }
  @keyframes flash-burst-anim{
    0%{ transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0); opacity:0.9; }
    100%{ transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(38); opacity:0; }
  }

  .envelope-eyebrow{
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:3px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color: var(--silver-bright);
    font-weight:500;
    margin-bottom:30px;
  }

  .envelope-btn{
    background:none;
    border:none;
    padding:0;
    cursor:pointer;
    display:inline-block;
  }

  .envelope-svg{
    width:230px;
    height:auto;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 26px rgba(63,127,224,0.35));
    animation: envelope-float 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
  }
  .envelope-btn:hover .envelope-svg{
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }
  .envelope-btn:active .envelope-svg{
    transform: scale(0.97);
  }
  @keyframes envelope-float{
    0%,100%{ transform: translateY(0); }
    50%{ transform: translateY(-10px); }
  }

  .envelope-hint{
    margin-top:28px;
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:2px;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color: var(--blue-electric);
    font-weight:600;
  }

  .back-arrow{
    position:absolute;
    top:6px;
    left:6px;
    width:38px;
    height:38px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    border:1px solid var(--silver-line);
    border-radius:50%;
    background: rgba(63,127,224,0.10);
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .back-arrow svg{ width:18px; height:18px; }
  .back-arrow:hover{ background: rgba(63,127,224,0.22); }

  .gift-icon{
    width:64px;
    height:64px;
    margin: 26px auto 18px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    border-radius:50%;
    border:1px solid var(--silver-line);
    background: rgba(63,127,224,0.10);
  }
  .gift-icon svg{ width:28px; height:28px; }

  .gift-message{
    font-size:15px;
    line-height:1.7;
    color:var(--silver);
    font-weight:300;
    max-width:320px;
    margin: 0 auto 22px;
  }

  .gift-alias{
    display:inline-block;
    font-size:20px;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:1px;
    color:var(--silver-bright);
    background: rgba(63,127,224,0.12);
    border:1px solid var(--silver-line);
    border-radius:2px;
    padding:14px 26px;
    margin-bottom:8px;
  }

  @media (max-width:420px){
    .eighteen{ font-size:105px; }
    .name{ font-size:32px; }
    .card{ padding:44px 22px 36px; }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{ animation: none !important; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="stars" id="stars"></div>

<div class="card">
  <div class="spotlight"></div>

  <svg class="confetti" style="top:40px; left:24px; animation-delay:0s;" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14"><rect width="14" height="14" rx="2" fill="#3f7fe0"/></svg>
  <svg class="confetti" style="top:90px; right:28px; animation-delay:1.2s;" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 10 10"><circle cx="5" cy="5" r="5" fill="#c9d4e3"/></svg>
  <svg class="confetti" style="bottom:130px; left:20px; animation-delay:2.4s;" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><rect width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="#c9d4e3" transform="rotate(20 8 8)"/></svg>
  <svg class="confetti" style="bottom:60px; right:24px; animation-delay:0.8s;" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="6" fill="#3f7fe0"/></svg>

  <div id="envelope-view">
    <div class="flash-burst" id="flashBurst"></div>
    <div class="envelope-eyebrow">Te ha llegado una invitación</div>
    <button type="button" class="envelope-btn" onclick="openInvitation()" aria-label="Abrir invitación">
      <svg class="envelope-svg" viewBox="0 0 240 170" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="envGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f0f4fb"/>
            <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#c9d4e3"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3f7fe0"/>
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        <rect x="4" y="4" width="232" height="162" rx="10" fill="url(#envGrad)" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.5)" stroke-width="2"/>
        <polygon points="4,166 120,90 4,14" fill="rgba(6,12,31,0.14)"/>
        <polygon points="236,166 120,90 236,14" fill="rgba(6,12,31,0.14)"/>
        <polygon points="4,14 120,90 236,14" fill="none" stroke="rgba(6,12,31,0.35)" stroke-width="2"/>
        <circle cx="120" cy="95" r="32" fill="#3f7fe0" stroke="#f0f4fb" stroke-width="3"/>
        <text x="120" y="107" font-family="'Luckiest Guy', sans-serif" font-size="36" fill="#f0f4fb" text-anchor="middle">18</text>
      </svg>
    </button>
    <div class="envelope-hint">Tocá para abrir</div>
  </div>

  <div id="main-view" style="display:none;">
  <div class="eyebrow" style="text-align:center;">Están todos invitados</div>

  <div class="hero-row">
    <div class="hero-photo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Facundo"></div>
    <div class="hero-text">
      <div class="eighteen">18</div>
      <div class="subtitle">CUMPLEAÑOS</div>
      <div class="name">Facundo</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="divider"></div>

  <div class="details">
    <div class="detail-row">
      <div class="detail-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#c9d4e3" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"/><line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-text">
        <div class="label">Fecha</div>
        <div class="value">Domingo 11 de octubre</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="detail-row">
      <div class="detail-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#c9d4e3" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-text">
        <div class="label">Hora</div>
        <div class="value">21:30 hs</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <a class="detail-row location-link" href="https://maps.app.goo.gl/LTAQJEqEYWuNhR5D6" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <div class="detail-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#c9d4e3" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 10c0 7-9 13-9 13s-9-6-9-13a9 9 0 0 1 18 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-text">
        <div class="label">Lugar</div>
        <div class="value">Quincho SUTEF<br>Monseñor Fagnano 1145, Río Grande</div>
      </div>
    </a>

    <button type="button" class="detail-row location-link" style="width:100%; border:1px solid var(--silver-line); font:inherit; cursor:pointer;" onclick="showGift()">
      <div class="detail-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#c9d4e3" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 12 20 22 4 22 4 12"/><rect x="2" y="7" width="20" height="5"/><line x1="12" y1="22" x2="12" y2="7"/><path d="M12 7H7.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0-5C11 2 12 7 12 7z"/><path d="M12 7h4.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 0-5C13 2 12 7 12 7z"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-text">
        <div class="label">¿Un detalle?</div>
        <div class="value">Regalo</div>
      </div>
    </button>

    <button type="button" class="detail-row location-link" style="width:100%; border:1px solid var(--silver-line); font:inherit; cursor:pointer;" onclick="showSong()">
      <div class="detail-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#c9d4e3" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"/></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-text">
        <div class="label">¿Tu tema favorito?</div>
        <div class="value">Sugerir canción</div>
      </div>
    </button>
  </div>

  <div class="countdown" id="countdown">
    <div class="countdown-unit"><div class="countdown-num" id="cd-days">00</div><div class="countdown-label">Días</div></div>
    <div class="countdown-unit"><div class="countdown-num" id="cd-hours">00</div><div class="countdown-label">Hs</div></div>
    <div class="countdown-unit"><div class="countdown-num" id="cd-min">00</div><div class="countdown-label">Min</div></div>
    <div class="countdown-unit"><div class="countdown-num" id="cd-sec">00</div><div class="countdown-label">Seg</div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="message">
    Vení a disfrutar de una noche inolvidable conmigo, te espero.
  </div>

  <div class="closing-photo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Facundo"></div>

  <a class="footer-line" href="https://w.app/apm9j7" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Confirmá tu asistencia</a>
  </div>

  <div id="gift-view" style="display:none;">
    <button type="button" class="back-arrow" onclick="showMain()" aria-label="Volver">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#f0f4fb" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"/><polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"/></svg>
    </button>
    <div class="gift-icon">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#3f7fe0" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 12 20 22 4 22 4 12"/><rect x="2" y="7" width="20" height="5"/><line x1="12" y1="22" x2="12" y2="7"/><path d="M12 7H7.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0-5C11 2 12 7 12 7z"/><path d="M12 7h4.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 0-5C13 2 12 7 12 7z"/></svg>
    </div>
    <div class="gift-message">Mi regalo es tu presencia,<br>pero si querés tener un detalle,<br>te dejo mi alias</div>
    <div class="gift-alias">facundonicora.mp</div>
  </div>

  <div id="song-view" style="display:none; position:relative; text-align:center; padding-top:6px;">
    <button type="button" class="back-arrow" onclick="showMain()" aria-label="Volver">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#f0f4fb" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"/><polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"/></svg>
    </button>
    <div class="gift-icon">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#3f7fe0" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"/></svg>
    </div>
    <div class="gift-message">Ayudanos a armar la playlist de la fiesta.<br>¿Qué canción no puede faltar?</div>
    <a class="footer-line" href="https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3lYOnuGLVnQjRlTpx1tQzf?si=ceea049b935d4a6f&pt=23411e3089b3a00575a85b7001595c94" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Sugerir en Spotify</a>
  </div>
</div>


<script>
  const starsContainer = document.getElementById('stars');
  const total = 60;
  for(let i=0;i<total;i++){
    const s = document.createElement('div');
    s.className='star';
    s.style.left = Math.random()*100+'vw';
    s.style.top = Math.random()*100+'vh';
    s.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*3.5)+'s';
    s.style.animationDuration = (2.5+Math.random()*3)+'s';
    starsContainer.appendChild(s);
  }

  // Cuenta regresiva hasta el 11 de octubre 21:30
  const targetDate = new Date('2026-10-11T21:30:00-03:00');
  function updateCountdown(){
    const now = new Date();
    let diff = targetDate - now;
    if(diff < 0) diff = 0;
    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000*60*60*24));
    const hours = Math.floor((diff % (1000*60*60*24)) / (1000*60*60));
    const mins = Math.floor((diff % (1000*60*60)) / (1000*60));
    const secs = Math.floor((diff % (1000*60)) / 1000);
    document.getElementById('cd-days').textContent = String(days).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('cd-hours').textContent = String(hours).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('cd-min').textContent = String(mins).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('cd-sec').textContent = String(secs).padStart(2,'0');
  }
  updateCountdown();
  setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);

  function openInvitation(){
    const env = document.getElementById('envelope-view');
    const main = document.getElementById('main-view');
    const flash = document.getElementById('flashBurst');

    flash.classList.add('burst');
    env.classList.add('closing');

    setTimeout(()=>{
      env.style.display = 'none';
      main.style.display = 'block';
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        main.classList.add('visible');
      });
    }, 420);
  }
  function showGift(){
    document.getElementById('main-view').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('gift-view').style.display = 'block';
  }
  function showSong(){
    document.getElementById('main-view').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('song-view').style.display = 'block';
  }
  function showMain(){
    document.getElementById('gift-view').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('song-view').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('main-view').style.display = 'block';
  }
</script>


</body>
</html>
